title: Former Ravens coach John Harbaugh's 1905 Maryland stone mansion sells for $6M
summary_full: Former Baltimore Ravens coach John Harbaugh has sold his historic stone mansion in Owings Mills, Maryland, for $6 million. He bought the 9-acre property for $3 million in 2013. Built in 1905, the 9,100-square-foot home has five bedrooms, a carriage house, four-car garage, pool, hot tub and multiple outdoor spaces.
